mapper.update: update tb_users set use_yn = 'N' where user_id = '${userId}'
mapper.select: SELECT a.menu_id AS menuId ,a.parent_id AS parentId ,a.menu_name AS menuName ,a.menu_path AS menuPath ,a.icon AS icon ,a.sort_order AS sortOrder ,a.menu_level AS menuLevel ,a.menu_type AS menuType ,ISNULL(b.read_yn, 'N') AS readYn ,ISNULL(b.write_yn, 'N') AS writeYn FROM tb_menu_mst a LEFT JOIN tb_menu_auth b ON b.menu_id = a.menu_id AND b.user_id = #{userId} WHERE a.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY a.menu_level,a.parent_id,a.sort_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_menu_auth (user_id,menu_id,read_yn,write_yn,reg_id,reg_dt) SELECT #{userId} ,m.menu_id ,'Y' ,'N' ,'SYSTEM' ,GETDATE() FROM tb_menu_mst m WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_menu_auth a WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.menu_id = m.menu_id )
